Appreciate the materials — the pilot SOW looks straightforward. Quick answers: we can provide a 30/90/365 tiered sheet (per GB/month) and an ingest metric priced by trace-units (roughly correlated to spans/sec). For pilots we normally offer a sandbox with full dashboard access and a capped ingest allowance for 60 days.

A few asks from our side to produce an accurate quote:
- Typical daily spans (or sample traces/day) you expect in the pilot
- Whether retention needs to be hot-storage (queryable) for the full period or archived after 30 days
- Are multi-project dashboards required (project isolation vs. org-level dashboards)

We'll put together a formal quote by EOD tomorrow and include a standard 15% pilot credit for first-time integrations. If you need a deeper commercial concession (higher discount or waived onboarding fee) we'll need a one-pager on expected ARR or a minimum committed spend.

Evan

Kim / Ben —

Forwarding Evan's note. Helio offered a 15% pilot credit but signaled they need a committed ARR to push deeper concessions. A few quick points I want guidance on before I respond:

1) Pilot structure — I'm inclined to offer a 60-day sandbox with full dashboard access, capped at 1M spans/day and 90-day retention hot for queries (archive beyond 90 days) as a free pilot. That keeps GA costs bounded but shows value.

2) Discount framing — if Helio wants an annual price commitment I'm proposing we offer:
   - 10% discount on add-on list pricing for a 12-month commit >= $120k ARR
   - 18% discount for >= $300k ARR (requires legal signoff)
   - Waived onboarding (one-time) for deals >= $250k ARR

3) Packaging — prefer to keep advanced dashboards as seatless project-level SKU to avoid seat management overhead. Price it as $0.02 per active user-hour or a flat project tier; the finance team prefers predictable slabs.

Attaching a quick concession table I patched together for their review. Please flag anything risky ( especially the 18% tier and waived onboarding).

Attachments: proposed_concession_table.csv

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the proposed table. My notes:

- Pilot: agree with 60-day sandbox + 1M spans/day cap. Make the retention hot for 90 days but require a clear handoff for archival after pilot end if they don't convert. That prevents open-ended costs.

- Discount bands: 10% for $120k ARR is fine to approve at your level. The 18% for $300k should be escalated to Legal/Revenue Ops — please route that through your manager with expected ARR math (LTV / payback).

- Onboarding waiver: we can waive the onboarding fee for strategic pilots, but only if PMM signs off that this is a high-propensity use case. Require a short outcomes document in HubSpot (we'll add it to the deal).

- Dashboard SKU: prefer flat project tiers (Small/Medium/Large) to avoid billing noise. Small=$1,200/mo, Medium=$4,500/mo, Large=$12,000/mo (examples). Ben, will Finance accept these provisional numbers for quoting?

I also updated the concession table to reflect a $250k ARR midpoint for waived onboarding and attached the updated CSV.

Kimberly
